title: Customer feedback quick-triage and wishlist (Feb 2027)
content:
Executive summary:
This is a rapid triage of inbound customer feedback collected between 2027-01-20 and 2027-02-10 (support tickets, AE notes, and two discovery interviews). Goal: identify immediate wins (<=2w), medium-term roadmap asks (1-3 months), and high-risk blockers. This is deliberately concise — see linked artifacts for full threads.

Methodology:
- Sources: 18 support threads, 4 AE call notes, 2 solutions-eng interviews, 3 product evaluation reports.
- Tagging: grouped by functional area (routing, billing/usage, API ergonomics, model quality, deployment).
- Prioritization: frequency, customer tier (enterprise vs startup), implementation complexity (rough eng estimate), and customer business impact.

Top items (ranked by urgency x impact):
1) Transparent per-request cost breakdown in Console API logs
- Frequency: 7 customers asked in last 3 weeks
- Sample quote: "Hard to justify TCO to finance without per-request token + batch overhead numbers"
- Hypothesis: customers need token-level economics to attribute spend to product features
- Suggested solution: add a collapsible per-request cost table in Console request detail (tokens, batch overhead, effective GPU-seconds estimate) + CSV export
- Rough effort: 2-3 sprint days (backend + Console view)
- Priority: high (enterprise ask)
- Owner: Analytics (proposal: Alex Chen)

2) Fallback routing policy visibility and override for Dedicated customers
- Frequency: 5 enterprise customers reported unexpected fallbacks
- Quote: "Our app latency spikes when your fallback kicks in — we need transparent rules and an override button"
- Hypothesis: Smart routing opacity causes operational surprises during regional capacity events
- Suggested solution: expose active routing policy per-route and a per-customer override toggle in Dedicated settings; include audit log entries
- Rough effort: 2-4 sprints (routing + auth + Console)
- Priority: high
- Owner: Platform eng (Diego Ramirez)

3) Shorten reboot/compile cold-path for private deployments (on-prem)
- Frequency: 3 customers on Private, 2 reported 10-15m cold starts after redeploys
- Impact: outage-sensitive workloads complain
- Suggested solution: investigate checkpointed KV preload and parallel kernel warmup; interim doc with mitigation steps
- Effort: investigation 1 sprint; fix TBD
- Priority: medium-high
- Owner: Serving-runtime (tagging SRE)

4) Better error messages for function/tool calling failures
- Frequency: repeated by developer users; confusing stack traces
- Suggested solution: map common tool errors to human-friendly guidance and sample retry patterns in SDK
- Effort: 3-4 engineering days + SDK docs update
- Priority: medium
- Owner: DevX (Sara Patel)

5) Quick embedding misalignment diagnostic (batch vs single)
- Frequency: 6 customers with degraded semantic search quality after bulk ingest
- Suggested solution: lightweight diagnostic script and Console check that flags inconsistent batch tokenization/normalization settings; provide migration checklist
- Effort: 1 sprint for script + docs
- Priority: medium
- Owner: Solutions Eng (Priya Nair)

Low-hanging wins (<= 2 weeks):
- Add note to Console docs clarifying difference between token billing and per-request overhead (docs edit, 1 day).
- Prebuilt Slack snippet for CS to explain fallback behavior (copy + paste, 1 day).
- Small SDK patch to improve a frequent error string (2 days).

Risk flags and unknowns:
- Conflicting asks between startups (need simple defaults) and enterprise (need configurability).
- Quantitative data missing: need token-level distribution over last 90 days to validate "per-request cost" UI design. Engineering to pull sample dataset (CS->Analytics).
- Private deployment customers may have highly customized infra; fixes need verification matrix.

Proposed next steps (2-week cadence):
- Week 0: Socialize this triage with Eng leads; get buy-in on 1) per-request cost view and 2) fallback visibility. (Owners: Priya -> schedule meeting; Diego & Alex).
- Week 1: Analytics to deliver sample token-distribution dataset (Jira: CS-3421).
- Weeks 1-3: Ship low-hanging wins (docs + Slack snippets + SDK patch). (Owners: Docs, CS, DevX).
- Month 1: Launch per-request cost beta for 3 enterprise customers; collect feedback. (Owner: Analytics + Console)

Appendix: notable customer quotes (anonymized):
- "We can accept 10-20% variance, but we need attribution down to the feature level" (Large fintech)
- "Fallbacks feel like a black box, we lost revenue during last region incident" (marketplace SaaS)
- "Embeddings mismatch after bulk load — search quality tanked and we lost trust" (media startup)

Quick references: full threads in linked artifacts, AE notes in GH-PR-512, longer synthesis in Confluence page above.

Notes to reviewer:
- This is intentionally terse. If you want, I can expand the Top items into a one-pager per item with stakeholders, success metrics, and rollout plan.
- Please flag anything you think should be re-prioritized before the 2027-02-25 sync.

Prepared by: Priya Nair (CS), 2027-02-14
Last update: 2027-02-21 (added low-hanging wins and owners)
